title: The Heir He Denied
body: So far I’m really enjoying this book. Aria, is a struggling young, orphaned she wolf in her werewolf pack. She’s constantly subjected to bullying and ridicule by ‘the mean girl squad’ of the pack. Upon discovering the newly ascended Alpha is her mate they have a passionate intimate tryst. And she was momentarily ecstatic. After the stolen moments Alpha Damon says she’s just too weak and frail to stand next to him before the whole pack as his mate and Luna. He wants someone strong confident and beautiful. After Damon cruelly rejects her he names Tiffany his chosen Luna. She’s everything he thinks he wants and needs, has a strong wolf where Aria has none, with her confidence and beauty. Aria is rejected publicly by her mate and flees the pack building a new life with her son, the proof of their encounter. A happy result of their one wildly passionate encounter. After leaving her wolf emerges and she goes from a weak, unsure, self deprecating wolf-less shadow in her pack to a confident, beautiful dynamic and renowned business woman. And so years later she comes face to face with Damon unaware a major business deal with a large partner company is helmed by Damon himself. And she’s unaware that he’d been searching for her since the night she fled his pack. What will happen now that they’re face to face and Aria’s forced to work with him? Will she flee to escape the pull they still have and to protect the secrecy of her son, and will Damon let her get away this time? What will happen to Aria once he lays eyes on his mini me, will he make her pay for hiding his son from him and what will happen when Tiffany finds out that not only is Aria’s son is the rightful heir to the pack she can see Damon wants his son and Aria in his life…..?
